logline: 어느 아침 몸이 달라진 채 깨어난 외판원이, 닫힌 방문 하나를 사이에 두고 가족과 멀어져 간다.
destination: 거실로 통하는 방문 — 그가 마지막으로 넘어서게 되는 자리
protagonist: 가족을 먹여 살리던 스물다섯 살 외판원
setting: 1910년대 프라하의 낡은 아파트, 좁은 방과 긴 복도
anchor: a cramped 1910s Prague bedroom with heavy dark furniture, a narrow bed and one tall shuttered window
palette: muted olive and ash grey, weak grey daylight, deep furniture shadow

beats.visual: morning light falling across a rumpled bed in a dim cramped bedroom, blanket pushed aside
beats.motion: light creeps across the blanket, dust turns in the beam, the sheet slides

beats.beat: 그는 제 몸을 일으키지 못하고 버둥거린다.
beats.visual: an overturned blanket heaving on a bed, bedframe rattling, slippers knocked over on the floor
beats.motion: the blanket heaves and drops, the bedframe shudders, a slipper tips over

beats.visual: three shadowed figures standing in a corridor outside a closed bedroom door, hands raised to knock
beats.motion: a hand raps the panel, shadows shift under the door, the handle turns and stops

beats.visual: a stout man in a bowler hat and overcoat waiting stiffly in a narrow hallway, hat brim low
beats.motion: he shifts his weight, his hat brim dips, hallway lamp flickers

beats.visual: a bedroom door swung open onto darkness, figures backing away down the corridor, chairs knocked aside
beats.motion: the door swings wide, figures stumble backward, a chair topples

beats.beat: 그는 방에 갇힌 채 문틈으로 거실을 내다본다.
beats.visual: a narrow band of lamplight through a barely open bedroom door, dark shape watching from inside
beats.motion: the band of light narrows, the shape shifts in the dark, dust turns

beats.beat: 그를 본 가족은 어떤 얼굴을 하게 될까?
beats.visual: a violin lowered mid-note, three faces turned toward an open doorway, sitting room lamp bright
beats.motion: the bow stops, heads turn together, the lamp flame steadies

beats.visual: an empty bedroom with the window standing wide open, curtain lifting, bed stripped bare
beats.motion: the curtain billows inward, light spreads across the floor, dust turns

withheld: 그가 방에서 홀로 맞는 마지막과, 그 뒤 가족이 나들이를 떠나는 대목
